description: This file handles executing AI phone calls within a workflow system, including parsing payloads, checking feature flags, rate limiting, credit validation, and invoking AI services to make calls based on booking or form response data.

classes.name: ExecuteAIPhoneCallPayload
classes.description: Interface defining the structure of the payload for executing an AI phone call.

methods.name: convertResponsesToVariableFormats
methods.description: Converts responses to variable format entries with both current and legacy formats for backward compatibility.

methods.name: getVariablesFromFormResponse
methods.description: Extracts variables from form responses, including attendee info and custom responses, for use in the AI call.

methods.name: getVariablesFromBooking
methods.description: Extracts variables from a booking object, including event details and attendee info, for use in the AI call.

methods.name: executeAIPhoneCall
methods.description: Main function that processes the payload, checks feature flags, rate limits, credits, and initiates the AI phone call, updating workflow status accordingly.
